Simulated FluSurvey data

Source: R/data.r
simulated_data.Rd

A small simulated data set in the format that extract_data reads: a list with one element per season (named "2013" and "2014", for the 2012/13 and 2013/14 seasons), each a list of the "background", "contact" and "symptom" questionnaires as returned by read_data. There are around 300 participants per season, of whom about 70 per cent take part in both seasons.

Usage

simulated_data

Format

A named list of seasons, each a named list of data.tables

Details

The data are not derived from any survey responses. data-raw/simulated_data.r generates them from the questionnaire definitions in questions and options alone, with a fixed random seed. The values are only plausible enough for the functions in this package to run on them. Do not use them to draw any conclusion about influenza-like illness.

Examples

names(simulated_data)
#> [1] "2013" "2014"
sapply(simulated_data[["2013"]], nrow)
#> background    contact    symptom 
#>        317        937       2879
